name: 11534-sonnetstream-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB; read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), TWO points in one run: streams=512 then streams=1024, each bounded at 10240 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 30% by completion. The 512 point is the scored one.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, streaming, `request_format: plain`. 250 prompt tokens (a 200-token shared prefix plus 50 request-specific tokens) and EXACTLY 200 output tokens, min = max on both. Prefix caching is off, so all 250 tokens are prefilled on every request; `ignore_eos` is pinned in `sampling_params`, so every request emits exactly 200 instead of stopping early on EOS.
purpose: A streaming eight-billion-parameter chat assistant writing fixed-length replies to short prompts for hundreds of concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# HAZARD: on this engine `enable_prefix_caching` defaults to ON under V1, and the workload's
# prompts share a 200-token prefix by construction. Dropping this line changes the request shape.
enable-prefix-caching: false

disable-log-requests: true

# HAZARD: an unset `max_num_seqs` resolves to 1024 with V1 and 256 without it. Written out
# because 256 would cap the declared operating point.
max-num-seqs: 1024

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

max-model-len: 4096
